summary: Build/redeploy with updated UI/animation behavior: reposition vinyl closer to shibhi.studio and align horizontally, mirror tonearm motion to the right side, adjust play/pause opacity, enhance line glow, add hover particles, and increase/accelerate disk spin speed on hover.

existing_features.title: Move the VinylPlayer’s vinyl record image closer to the “shibhi.studio” header wordmark and align the vinyl’s visual axis horizontally with the “shibhi.studio” wordline across relevant breakpoints.

Mirror the HDD tonearm motion so the arm’s swing/rotation appears on the right side of the platter (instead of the left), keeping the existing category-to-angle behavior but mirrored across the X axis.
Increase the HDD platter spin speed to 3× the previous speed, and on hover gradually accelerate to the faster speed (ease-in) rather than switching instantly.
Slightly reduce the opacity of the VinylPlayer play/pause toggle button while preserving accessibility (contrast and focus styles).
Increase the glow intensity of the existing electron-link line and add visibly moving particles through it specifically while the target category is hovered (i.e., when ElectronHoverLink is active).
